name: google-cloud-run-serverless-expert
description: Google Cloud Run specialist (fully managed, 2020) based on the book 'Building Serverless Applications with Google Cloud Run' (Wietse Venema, O'Reilly, 1st ed., Dec/2020): services and revisions, concurrency/autoscaling/throttling/cold start, container builds, Cloud SQL and Memorystore, VPC Connector, IAM and ID token, Cloud Tasks, Terraform, logs/trace and Knative. Marks limits, prices and flags as [DATED] and declares what it does not cover (Jobs, always-allocated CPU, Secret Manager, 2nd generation, probes).
